project: Dr Plant multi-crop PlantVillage baseline v1
limitations: Metrics apply only to these source datasets and this split, not Syrian coastal orchards.
Dataset class labels may not be laboratory-confirmed pathogens.
This is a baseline, not a production-validated model.

Exploratory mode bypasses expert-label and near-duplicate review gates; image-level split may leak plant/session/background information and is not independent validation. Do not advertise these metrics as accuracy on unseen farms.
CPU-only fast baseline: the MobileNet feature extractor was frozen and only the final classification layer was trained.
Balanced subset: 50 source-train and 20 source-test images per class; not full-dataset training.
Image dataset results are not field validation and must not be interpreted as expected accuracy on Syrian farms.
license_note: Review the upstream PlantVillage dataset license and obligations for model derivatives before commercial distribution.
